rows.text: How do I create a priority map?
rows.reply: To build a priority map in Kenya: 1) In Add Layers, pick Demand layers (population, nighttime lights, productive uses) and Supply layers (GHI, grid). 2) In Active Layers, set each layer's range and importance. 3) Choose the index (now Energy Access Potential). 4) Open Show Analysis Results. Or tell me the intervention (grid, mini-grid or stand-alone PV) and I'll set it up.

rows.text: What is the difference between the indexes?
rows.reply: EAE has four indexes. Energy Access Potential combines demand and supply (the recommended default). Demand Index uses demographics and social/productive uses. Supply Index uses resources and infrastructure. Assistance Need Index highlights high need, low economic activity and low access to infrastructure. Current: Energy Access Potential.
